subject: Pilot interest: embeddings + rerank — scheduling demo
messages:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@parcelleaf.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Interested in Redwood for embeddings + rerank pilot

Hi Hannah,

I signed up for the self-serve sandbox yesterday and poked around the embeddings endpoint — nice docs. We're ParcelLeaf (e‑commerce logistics) and evaluating an embeddings + reranking flow to replace an in-house semantic search that stumbles on short queries.

High level: we expect ~2M searches/month initially, peaking at ~300 qps for short bursts. Latency target is p95 < 200ms, and we care about cost per 1k queries. We're planning a small pilot (2–3 week) to validate quality and integration.

Can we get a short demo and a quick sync on traffic expectations / recommended config? I'm in PST; roughly available Wed/Thu afternoons. Attaching a brief traffic snapshot.

Thanks,
Sanjay Patel
Head of ML, ParcelLeaf Inc
(sanjay@parcelleaf.com)

Attachment: parcelleaf-traffic-snapshot.csv (CSV, 42KB)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@parcelleaf.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood for embeddings + rerank pilot

Hi Sanjay — great to meet you and thanks for trying the sandbox. I looped in Ben from our SDR team to help coordinate the demo. Before we lock a time, two quick clarifying questions so we tailor the session: 

- Primary use case: production search (customer facing) or internal tooling / analytics?
- Typical request shape: average tokens per query and average document size (tokens) you’ll index?
- Expected concurrency distribution: sustained qps vs burst qps and typical burst length (mins). You mentioned 300 qps bursts — are those daily spikes or seasonal events?
- Timeline & success criteria: is the 2–3 week pilot a POC to demo to stakeholders, or do you need a production-ready rollout after pilot?
- Any compliance requirements (data residency, logging, SOC2) we should call out up front?

If you prefer, share answers and we’ll propose three slots — or pick from my Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/hannah-30m

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise SDR Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@parcelleaf.com>

Date: Wed, 11 Jan 2028 08:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood for embeddings + rerank pilot

Thanks Hannah — answers below inline.

- Use case: customer-facing product search on our storefront; ranking + semantic fallback for short queries.
- Query size: median 6 tokens; documents average ~120 tokens (product title + short description).
- Concurrency: baseline ~30 qps; heavy campaign bursts up to ~300 qps for ~15–45 minutes, a few times per day during peak campaigns.
- Timeline: pilot in two weeks is ideal; success = comparable recall to our current model with 30–40% lower per‑query cost. If pilot validates, goal is phased rollout over 2 months.
- Compliance: US-first; SOC2 optional for pilot but would need it for production.

Slots (PST) that work for us: Thu Jan 12 11:00–11:30, Thu Jan 12 14:00–14:30, Fri Jan 13 09:00–09:30. Prefer Thu 14:00 if available.

Also happy to provide a small test corpus and temporary API keys for volume checks.

—Sanjay
